quotaSource: TTD releases each month's quota about three months ahead on a fixed pattern. Its notices for December 2026 and January 2027 both used the days shown. Dates for later months are projected from that pattern; TTD confirms each one a few days before.

quotaPattern.name: Arjitha sevas: electronic lucky dip registration
quotaPattern.note: Suprabhatam, Thomala, Archana, Ashtadala Pada Padmaradhana. Registration open for 2 days, then pay within 2 days if selected.

Virtual seva participation with darshan slot
Senior citizens, differently abled, chronically ill quota

quotaPattern.note: The most contested quota. Log in a few minutes early; popular dates sell out within the hour.

occasions.name: Deepavali
occasions.note: Deepavali Asthanam at the Srivari temple; AP public holiday.

occasions.name: Pushpayagam
occasions.note: Flower offering to the Malayappa Swamy; some arjitha sevas are cancelled that day.

occasions.name: Kaisika Ekadasi and Dwadasi
occasions.note: Uttana Ekadasi; Ugra Srinivasa procession at dawn on Dwadasi.

occasions.name: Karthika Pournami Deepotsavam
occasions.note: Full moon of Karthika, with lamps lit across the temple.

occasions.name: Tiruchanur Padmavathi Ammavari Brahmotsavam
occasions.note: At Tiruchanur near Tirupati. Panchami Theertham on the last day draws the biggest crowd.

occasions.name: Vaikuntha Ekadasi and Vaikuntha Dwara darshan
occasions.note: Ten days of Vaikuntha Dwara darshan, overlapping Christmas holidays. TTD usually issues dedicated tokens and suspends most other darshan types.

occasions.name: New Year's Day
occasions.note: Last year it fell inside the Vaikuntha Dwara window.

occasions.name: Bhogi, Sankranti, Kanuma
occasions.note: Harvest festival; schools in AP and Telangana close for about a week.

occasions.name: Ratha Saptami
occasions.note: One-day 'mini Brahmotsavam': seven vahanams from sunrise to night.

occasions.name: Ugadi
occasions.note: Telugu new year; Ugadi Asthanam at the temple.

occasions.name: Summer holidays
occasions.note: The heaviest stretch of the year outside festivals. Last year the queue spilled outside the complex on most mornings.

calendarSource: Dates from Hindu panchang calendars and TTD announcements; those marked expected are not yet confirmed by TTD.
